prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1309; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for the claim file. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just go by the claim number, if that's okay.

Q: That works for the file. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection?

A: I was making a left turn at a signaled intersection in Conroe, Texas. The light had turned yellow and I was clearing the intersection when a vehicle coming the other way hit the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Had you already started your turn when the light changed?

A: I started the turn on a green arrow, I'm pretty sure. The other car came through on the straight-through lane as I was crossing.

Q: Were you looking at the oncoming traffic before you turned?

A: I checked, yes. There was a gap, or at least I thought there was. I didn't see the other car until it was almost on me.

Q: Did you notice any damage or injuries right after the impact?

A: My car was pushed sideways and the airbag deployed. My right shoulder hit the door frame and it's been hurting pretty badly since. I was able to get out on my own but I was sore right away.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment since the collision?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and they told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist. I have an appointment scheduled and I'm doing physical therapy exercises at home.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about how the accident happened?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I believe the other driver was going faster than the posted limit. That's about all I can tell you.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you once we've reviewed the information.

A: Okay, thanks.
